postgresql.audit_note: Verify server_version, package or image, extensions, managed-service compatibility and restore path.

mysql.release_model: LTS and Innovation are separate production-grade tracks; 9.7 is Innovation, not LTS
mysql.audit_note: Verify exact edition, patch, support policy, upgrade checker, connector and operating-system support.

mariadb.audit_note: Treat MariaDB as a distinct engine from Oracle MySQL and verify the exact patch at execution time.

sqlite.audit_note: Verify sqlite_version(), sqlite_source_id(), compile options, binding, journal mode and actual filesystem behavior from the application process.

recovery.postgresql: base backup plus continuous WAL archive for PITR
recovery.mysql: consistent backup plus binary logs and known coordinates or GTID for PITR
recovery.sqlite: online Backup API, VACUUM INTO or another supported coordinated method
recovery.principle: A backup is not valid until an isolated restore and application-level verification succeed.
